ADSB_CALLSIGN_2.description:

ADSB_SQUAWK.description: This parameter defines the squawk code. Value should be between 0000 and 7777.

ASPD_BETA_GATE.summary: Gate size for sideslip angle fusion
ASPD_BETA_GATE.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

ASPD_BETA_NOISE.description: Sideslip measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_DO_CHECKS.description:
Controls which checks are run to check airspeed data for validity. Only applied if ASPD_PRIMARY > 0.
Note: The missing data check (bit 0) is implicitly always enabled when ASPD_DO_CHECKS > 0, even if bit 0 is not explicitly set.
choices: Bitmask: 0: Only data missing check (triggers if more than 1s no data), 1: Data stuck (triggers if data is exactly constant for 2s in FW mode), 2: Innovation check (see ASPD_FS_INNOV), 3: Load factor check (triggers if measurement is below stall speed), 4: First principle check (airspeed change vs. throttle and pitch)
0: Fallback only to other airspeed sensors
2: Fallback to thrust based airspeed estimation

ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.summary: First principle airspeed check time window
ASPD_FP_T_WINDOW.description:
Window for comparing airspeed change to throttle and pitch change.
Triggers when the airspeed change within this window is negative while throttle increases
and the vehicle pitches down.
Is meant to catch degrading airspeed blockages as can happen when flying through icing conditions.
Relies on  FW_THR_TRIM being set accurately.

ASPD_FS_INNOV.description:
This specifies the minimum airspeed innovation required to trigger a failsafe. Larger values make the check less sensitive,
smaller values make it more sensitive. Large innovations indicate an inconsistency between predicted (groundspeed - windspeeed)
and measured airspeed.
The time required to detect a fault when the threshold is exceeded depends on the size of the exceedance and is controlled by the ASPD_FS_INTEG parameter.

ASPD_FS_INTEG.description:
This sets the time integral of airspeed innovation exceedance above ASPD_FS_INNOV required to trigger a failsafe.
Larger values make the check less sensitive, smaller positive values make it more sensitive.

ASPD_FS_T_START.description:
Delay before switching back to using airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is good.
Set to a negative value to disable the re-enabling in flight.

ASPD_FS_T_STOP.description: Delay before stopping use of airspeed sensor if checks indicate sensor is bad.

ASPD_PRIMARY.summary: Index or primary airspeed measurement source

ASPD_SCALE_1.description: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the first airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_2.description: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the second airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_3.description: This is the scale IAS --> CAS of the third airspeed sensor instance

ASPD_SCALE_APPLY.summary: Controls when to apply the new estimated airspeed scale(s)
choices: 0: Do not automatically apply the estimated scale
1: Apply the estimated scale after disarm
2: Apply the estimated scale in air

ASPD_SCALE_NSD.summary: Wind estimator true airspeed scale process noise spectral density
ASPD_SCALE_NSD.description:
Airspeed scale process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.
When unaided, the scale uncertainty (1-sigma, unitless) increases by this amount every second.

ASPD_TAS_GATE.summary: Gate size for true airspeed fusion
ASPD_TAS_GATE.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

ASPD_TAS_NOISE.summary: Wind estimator true airspeed measurement noise
ASPD_TAS_NOISE.description: True airspeed measurement noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.

ASPD_WERR_THR.summary: Horizontal wind uncertainty threshold for valid ground-minus-wind
ASPD_WERR_THR.description:
The airspeed alternative derived from groundspeed and heading will be declared valid
as soon and as long the horizontal wind uncertainty is below this value.

ASPD_WIND_NSD.summary: Wind estimator wind process noise spectral density
ASPD_WIND_NSD.description:
Wind process noise of the internal wind estimator(s) of the airspeed selector.
When unaided, the wind estimate uncertainty (1-sigma, in m/s) increases by this amount every second.

ATT_ACC_COMP.summary: Acceleration compensation based on GPS velocity

ATT_EN.description: Enable standalone quaternion based attitude estimator.

ATT_EXT_HDG_M.summary: External heading usage mode (from Motion capture/Vision)
ATT_EXT_HDG_M.description:
Set to 1 to use heading estimate from vision.
Set to 2 to use heading from motion capture.

ATT_MAG_DECL.description:
This parameter is not used in normal operation,
as the declination is looked up based on the
GPS coordinates of the vehicle.

ATT_W_MAG.description: Set to 0 to avoid using the magnetometer.

FW_AT_APPLY.summary: Controls when to apply the new gains
FW_AT_APPLY.description:
After the auto-tuning sequence is completed,
a new set of gains is available and can be applied
immediately or after landing.
choices: 0: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
1: Apply the new gains after disarm
2: Apply the new gains in air

FW_AT_AXES.description:
Defines which axes will be tuned during the auto-tuning sequence
Set bits in the following positions to enable:
0 : Roll
1 : Pitch
2 : Yaw

FW_AT_MAN_AUX.summary: Enable/disable auto tuning using a manual control AUX input
FW_AT_MAN_AUX.description: Defines which RC_MAP_AUXn parameter maps the manual control channel used to enable/disable auto tuning.

FW_AT_SYSID_F0.summary: Start frequency of the injected signal
FW_AT_SYSID_F0.description: Can be set lower or higher than the end frequency

FW_AT_SYSID_F1.summary: End frequency of the injected signal
FW_AT_SYSID_F1.description: Can be set lower or higher than the start frequency

FW_AT_SYSID_TIME.description: Duration of the input signal sent on each axis during system identification

FW_AT_SYSID_TYPE.description: Type of signal used during system identification to excite the system.

MC_AT_APPLY.summary: Controls when to apply the new gains
MC_AT_APPLY.description:
After the auto-tuning sequence is completed,
a new set of gains is available and can be applied
immediately or after landing.
WARNING Applying the gains in air is dangerous as there is no
guarantee that those new gains will be able to stabilize
the drone properly.
choices: 0: Do not apply the new gains (logging only)
1: Apply the new gains after disarm
2: WARNING Apply the new gains in air

MC_AT_RISE_TIME.summary: Desired angular rate closed-loop rise time

BAT1_CAPACITY.description: Defines the capacity of battery 1 in mAh.

BAT1_N_CELLS.description: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT1_R_INTERNAL.summary: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 1
BAT1_R_INTERNAL.description: If non-negative, then this will be used instead of the online estimated internal resistance.

BAT1_SOURCE.description:
This parameter controls the source of battery data. The value 'Power Module / Analog'
means that measurements are expected to come from either analog (ADC) inputs
or an I2C power monitor (e.g. INA226). Analog inputs are voltage and current
measurements read from the board's ADC channels, typically from an onboard
voltage divider and current shunt, or an external analog power module.
I2C power monitors are digital sensors on the I2C bus.
If the value is set to 'External' then the system expects to receive MAVLink
or CAN battery status messages, or the battery data is published by an external driver.
If the value is set to 'ESCs', the battery information are taken from the esc_status message.
This requires the ESC to provide both voltage as well as current (via ESC telemetry).

BAT1_V_CHARGED.description:
Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered full.
For a more accurate estimate set this below the nominal voltage of e.g. 4.2V

BAT1_V_EMPTY.description:
Defines the voltage where a single cell of the battery is considered empty.
The voltage should be chosen above the steep dropoff at 3.5V. A typical
lithium battery can only be discharged under high load down to 10% before
it drops off to a voltage level damaging the cells.

BAT2_N_CELLS.description: Defines the number of cells the attached battery consists of.

BAT2_R_INTERNAL.summary: Explicitly defines the per cell internal resistance for battery 2

BAT_AVRG_CURRENT.description:
This value is used to initialize the in-flight average current estimation,
which in turn is used for estimating remaining flight time and RTL triggering.

BAT_CRIT_THR.description:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as critically low.
This has to be lower than the low threshold. This threshold commonly
will trigger RTL.

BAT_EMERGEN_THR.description:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as dangerously low.
This has to be lower than the critical threshold. This threshold commonly
will trigger landing.

BAT_LOW_THR.description:
Sets the threshold when the battery will be reported as low.
This has to be higher than the critical threshold.

TRIG_ACT_TIME.description: This parameter sets the time the trigger needs to pulled high or low.

TRIG_DISTANCE.description: Sets the distance at which to trigger the camera.

TRIG_INTERVAL.description: This parameter sets the time between two consecutive trigger events

TRIG_MIN_INTERVA.description:
This parameter sets the minimum time between two consecutive trigger events
the specific camera setup is supporting.

TRIG_POLARITY.description: This parameter sets the polarity of the trigger (0 = active low, 1 = active high )

TRIG_PWM_NEUTRAL.summary: PWM neutral output on trigger pin

CBRK_BUZZER.description:
Setting this parameter to 782097 will disable the buzzer audio notification.
Setting this parameter to 782090 will disable the startup tune, while keeping
all others enabled.

CBRK_FLIGHTTERM.description:
Setting this parameter to 121212 will disable the flight termination action if triggered
by the FailureDetector logic or if FMU is lost.
This circuit breaker does not affect the RC loss, data link loss, geofence,
and takeoff failure detection safety logic.

CBRK_IO_SAFETY.description:
Setting this parameter to 22027 will disable IO safety.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.summary: Circuit breaker for power supply check
CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK.description:
Setting this parameter to 894281 will disable the power valid
checks in the commander.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

CBRK_USB_CHK.summary: Circuit breaker for USB link check
CBRK_USB_CHK.description:
Setting this parameter to 197848 will disable the USB connected
checks in the commander, setting it to 0 keeps them enabled (recommended).
We are generally recommending to not fly with the USB link
connected and production vehicles should set this parameter to
zero to prevent users from flying USB powered. However, for R&D purposes
it has proven over the years to work just fine.

CBRK_VTOLARMING.summary: Circuit breaker for arming in fixed-wing mode check
CBRK_VTOLARMING.description:
Setting this parameter to 159753 will enable arming in fixed-wing
mode for VTOLs.
WARNING: ENABLING THIS CIRCUIT BREAKER IS AT OWN RISK

COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT.summary: Set the actuator failure failsafe mode
COM_ACT_FAIL_ACT.description:
Note: actuator failure needs to be enabled and configured via FD_ACT_*
parameters.

COM_ARMABLE.description: Set 0 to prevent accidental use of the vehicle e.g. for safety or maintenance reasons.

COM_ARM_AUTH_ID.description: Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_AUTH_MET.description:
Methods:
- one arm: request authorization and arm when authorization is received
- two step arm: 1st arm command request an authorization and
2nd arm command arm the drone if authorized
Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.description: By default off. The default allows to arm the vehicle without a arm authorization.

COM_ARM_AUTH_TO.description:
Timeout for authorizer answer.
Used if arm authorization is requested by COM_ARM_AUTH_REQ.

COM_ARM_BAT_MIN.description:
Threshold for battery percentage below arming is prohibited.
A negative value means BAT_CRIT_THR is the threshold.

COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS.summary: Enable checks on ESCs that report telemetry
COM_ARM_CHK_ESCS.description:
If this parameter is set, the system will check ESC's online status and failures.
This param is specific for ESCs reporting status. It shall be used only if ESCs support telemetry.

COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK.summary: Enable FMU SD card hardfault / watchdog detection check
COM_ARM_HFLT_CHK.description:
This check detects if there are hardfault / watchdog files present on the
SD card. If so, and the parameter is enabled, arming is prevented.

COM_ARM_IMU_ACC.summary: Maximum accelerometer inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

COM_ARM_IMU_GYR.summary: Maximum rate gyro inconsistency between IMU units that will allow arming

COM_ARM_MAG_ANG.summary: Maximum magnetic field inconsistency between units that will allow arming

COM_ARM_MAG_STR.description:
Check if the estimator detects a strong magnetic
disturbance (check enabled by EKF2_MAG_CHECK)

COM_ARM_MIS_REQ.description: The default allows to arm the vehicle without a valid mission.

COM_ARM_ODID.summary: Enable Drone ID system detection and health check
COM_ARM_ODID.description:
This check detects if the Open Drone ID system is missing.
Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only or deny arming.
choices: 2: Enforce Open Drone ID system presence

COM_ARM_SDCARD.summary: Enable FMU SD card detection check
COM_ARM_SDCARD.description:
This check detects if the FMU SD card is missing.
Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only or deny arming.

COM_ARM_SWISBTN.summary: Arm switch is a momentary button
COM_ARM_SWISBTN.description:
0: Arming/disarming triggers on switch transition.
1: Arming/disarming triggers when holding the momentary button down like the stick gesture.

COM_ARM_TRAFF.summary: Enable Traffic Avoidance system detection check
COM_ARM_TRAFF.description:
This check detects if a traffic avoidance system (ADSB/FLARM transponder)
is missing. Depending on the value of the parameter, the check can be
disabled, warn only, or deny arming.

COM_ARM_WO_GPS.description:
Configures whether arming is allowed without GNSS, for modes that require a global position
(specifically, in those modes when a check defined by EKF2_GPS_CHECK fails).
The settings deny arming and warn, allow arming and warn, or silently allow arming.

COM_CPU_MAX.summary: Maximum allowed CPU load to still arm
COM_CPU_MAX.description:
The check fails if the CPU load is above this threshold for 2s.
A negative value disables the check.

COM_DISARM_LAND.summary: Time-out for auto disarm after landing
COM_DISARM_LAND.description:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time-out period in seconds after which the vehicle will be
automatically disarmed in case a landing situation has been detected during this period.
A zero or negative value means that automatic disarming triggered by landing detection is disabled.

COM_DISARM_MAN.summary: Allow disarming via switch/stick/button on multicopters in manual thrust modes
COM_DISARM_MAN.description:
0: Disallow disarming when not landed
1: Allow disarming in multicopter flight in modes where
the thrust is directly controlled by thr throttle stick
e.g. Stabilized, Acro

COM_DISARM_PRFLT.summary: Time-out for auto disarm if not taking off
COM_DISARM_PRFLT.description:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the time in seconds, within which the
vehicle is expected to take off after arming. In case the vehicle didn't takeoff
within the timeout it disarms again.
A negative value disables autmoatic disarming triggered by a pre-takeoff timeout.

COM_DLL_EXCEPT.description:
Specify modes in which ground control station connection loss is ignored and no failsafe action is triggered.
See also COM_RCL_EXCEPT.
choices: Bitmask: 0: Mission, 1: Auto modes, 2: Offboard, 3: External Mode, 4: Altitude Cruise

COM_DL_LOSS_T.description: After this amount of seconds without datalink, the GCS connection lost mode triggers

COM_FAIL_ACT_T.summary: Delay between failsafe condition triggered and failsafe reaction
COM_FAIL_ACT_T.description:
Before entering failsafe (RTL, Land, Hold), wait COM_FAIL_ACT_T seconds in Hold mode
for the user to realize.
During that time the user can switch modes, but cannot take over control via the stick override feature (see COM_RC_OVERRIDE).
Afterwards the configured failsafe action is triggered and the user may use stick override.
A zero value disables the delay.

COM_FLIGHT_UUID.description:
This number is incremented automatically after every flight on
disarming in order to remember the next flight UUID.
The first flight is 0.

COM_FLTMODE1.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE2.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE3.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE4.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE5.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTMODE6.description:
If the main switch channel is in this range the
selected flight mode will be applied.

COM_FLTT_LOW_ACT.description:
Action the system takes when the remaining flight time is below
the estimated time it takes to reach the RTL destination.

COM_FLT_PROFILE.description:
Describes the intended use of the vehicle.
Can be used by ground control software or log post processing.
This param does not influence the behavior within the firmware. This means for example the control logic is independent of the setting of this param (but depends on other params).

COM_FLT_TIME_MAX.description:
The vehicle aborts the current operation and returns to launch when
the time since takeoff is above this value. It is not possible to resume the
mission or switch to any auto mode other than RTL or Land. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.
Starting from 90% of the maximum flight time, a warning message will be sent
every 1 minute with the remaining time until automatic RTL.
Set to -1 to disable.

COM_FORCE_SAFETY.description: Force safety when the vehicle disarms

COM_HLDL_LOSS_T.summary: High Latency Datalink loss time threshold
COM_HLDL_LOSS_T.description: After this amount of seconds without datalink the data link lost mode triggers

COM_HLDL_REG_T.summary: High Latency Datalink regain time threshold
COM_HLDL_REG_T.description:
After a data link loss: after this number of seconds with a healthy datalink the 'datalink loss'
flag is set back to false

COM_HOME_EN.description:
Set home position automatically if possible.
During missions, the latitude/longitude of the home position is locked and will not reset during intermediate landings.
It will only update once the mission is complete or landed outside of a mission.
However, the altitude is still being adjusted to correct for GNSS vertical drift in the first 2 minutes after takeoff.

COM_HOME_IN_AIR.summary: Allows setting the home position after takeoff
COM_HOME_IN_AIR.description:
If set to true, the autopilot is allowed to set its home position after takeoff
The true home position is back-computed if a local position is estimate if available.
If no local position is available, home is set to the current position.

COM_IMB_PROP_ACT.description:
Action the system takes when an imbalanced propeller is detected by the failure detector.
See also FD_IMB_PROP_THR to set the failure threshold.

COM_KILL_DISARM.summary: Timeout value for disarming when kill switch is engaged
COM_KILL_DISARM.description: Use RC_MAP_KILL_SW to map a kill switch.

COM_LKDOWN_TKO.summary: Timeout for detecting a failure after takeoff
COM_LKDOWN_TKO.description:
A non-zero, positive value specifies the timeframe in seconds within failure detector is allowed to disarm the vehicle
if attitude exceeds the limits defined in FD_FAIL_P and FD_FAIL_R.
The check is not executed for flight modes that do support acrobatic maneuvers, e.g: Acro (MC/FW) and Manual (FW).
A zero or negative value means that the check is disabled.

COM_LOW_BAT_ACT.description:
Action the system takes at critical battery. See also BAT_CRIT_THR and BAT_EMERGEN_THR
for definition of battery states.
choices: 3: Return at critical level, land at emergency level

COM_MODE0_HASH.description:
This parameter is automatically set to identify external modes. It ensures that modes
get assigned to the same index independent from their startup order,
which is required when mapping an external mode to an RC switch.

COM_MODE_ARM_CHK.summary: Allow external mode registration while armed
COM_MODE_ARM_CHK.description: By default disabled for safety reasons

COM_MOT_TEST_EN.description:
If set, enables the actuator test interface via MAVLink (ACTUATOR_TEST), that
allows spinning the motors and moving the servos for testing purposes.

COM_OBC_LOSS_T.summary: Time-out to wait when onboard computer connection is lost before warning about loss connection

COM_OBL_RC_ACT.description:
The offboard loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_OF_LOSS_T in seconds.

COM_OF_LOSS_T.summary: Time-out to wait when offboard connection is lost before triggering offboard lost action

COM_PARACHUTE.summary: Require MAVLink parachute system to be present and healthy

COM_POS_FS_EPH.summary: Horizontal position error threshold for hovering systems
COM_POS_FS_EPH.description:
This is the horizontal position error (EPH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
If the previous position error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).
Only used for multicopters and VTOLs in hover mode.
Independent from estimator positioning data timeout threshold (see EKF2_NOAID_TOUT).
Set to -1 to disable.

COM_POS_LOW_ACT.description:
Action the system takes when the estimated position has an accuracy below the specified threshold.
See COM_POS_LOW_EPH to set the failsafe threshold.
The failsafe action is only executed if the vehicle is in auto mission or auto loiter mode,
otherwise it is only a warning.

COM_POS_LOW_EPH.description:
This triggers the action specified in COM_POS_LOW_ACT if the estimated position accuracy is below this threshold.
Local position has to be still declared valid, which requires some kind of velocity aiding or large dead-reckoning time (EKF2_NOAID_TOUT),
and a high failsafe threshold (COM_POS_FS_EPH).
Set to -1 to disable.

COM_POWER_COUNT.summary: Required number of redundant power modules
COM_POWER_COUNT.description:
This configures a check to verify the expected number of 5V rail power supplies are present. By default only one is expected.
Note: CBRK_SUPPLY_CHK disables all power checks including this one.

COM_PREARM_MODE.description:
Condition to enter the prearmed state, an intermediate state between disarmed and armed
in which non-throttling actuators are active.

COM_RAM_MAX.summary: Maximum allowed RAM usage to pass checks
COM_RAM_MAX.description:
The check fails if the RAM usage is above this threshold.
A negative value disables the check.

COM_RCL_EXCEPT.description:
Specify modes in which stick input is ignored and no failsafe action is triggered.
External modes requiring stick input will still failsafe.
Auto modes are: Hold, Takeoff, Land, RTL, Descend, Follow Target, Precland, Orbit.
choices: Bitmask: 0: Mission, 1: Auto modes, 2: Offboard, 3: External Mode, 4: Altitude Cruise

COM_RC_IN_MODE.description:
Selects stick input selection behavior:
either a traditional remote control receiver (RC) or a MAVLink joystick (MANUAL_CONTROL message)
Priority sources are immediately switched to whenever they get valid.
0 RC only. Requires valid RC calibration.
1 MAVLink only. RC and related checks are disabled.
2 Switches only if current source becomes invalid.
3 Locks to the first valid source until reboot.
4 Ignores all sources.
5 RC priority, then MAVLink (lower instance before higher)
6 MAVLink priority (lower instance before higher), then RC
7 RC priority, then MAVLink (higher instance before lower)
8 MAVLink priority (higher instance before lower), then RC

COM_RC_LOSS_T.description:
The time in seconds without a new setpoint from RC or Joystick, after which the connection is considered lost.
This must be kept short as the vehicle will use the last supplied setpoint until the timeout triggers.
Ensure the value is not set lower than the update interval of the RC or Joystick.

COM_RC_OVERRIDE.description:
When enabled, moving the sticks more than COM_RC_STICK_OV
immediately gives control back to the pilot by switching to Position mode and
if position is unavailable Altitude mode.
Note: Only has an effect on multicopters, and VTOLs in multicopter mode.
choices: Bitmask: 0: Enable override during auto modes (except for in critical battery reaction), 1: Enable override during offboard mode

COM_RC_STICK_OV.description:
If COM_RC_OVERRIDE is enabled and the joystick input is moved more than this threshold
the autopilot the pilot takes over control.

COM_SPOOLUP_TIME.summary: Enforced delay between arming and further navigation
COM_SPOOLUP_TIME.description:
The minimal time from arming the motors until moving the vehicle is possible is COM_SPOOLUP_TIME seconds.
Goal:
- Motors and propellers spool up to idle speed before getting commanded to spin faster
- Timeout for ESCs and smart batteries to successfulyy do failure checks
e.g. for stuck rotors before the vehicle is off the ground

COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.summary: Action after TAKEOFF has been accepted
COM_TAKEOFF_ACT.description: The mode transition after TAKEOFF has completed successfully.

COM_THROW_EN.description: Allows to start the vehicle by throwing it into the air.

COM_THROW_SPEED.summary: Minimum speed for the throw start
COM_THROW_SPEED.description:
When the throw launch is enabled, the drone will only allow motors to spin after this speed
is exceeded before detecting the freefall. This is a safety feature to ensure the drone does
not turn on after accidental drop or a rapid movement before the throw.
Set to 0 to disable.

COM_VEL_FS_EVH.description:
This is the horizontal velocity error (EVH) threshold that will trigger a failsafe.
The default is appropriate for a multicopter. Can be increased for a fixed-wing.
If the previous velocity error was below this threshold, there is an additional
factor of 2.5 applied (threshold for invalidation 2.5 times the one for validation).

COM_WIND_MAX.description:
Wind speed threshold above which an automatic failsafe action is triggered.
Failsafe action can be specified with COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.

COM_WIND_MAX_ACT.description:
Action the system takes when a wind speed above the specified threshold is detected.
See COM_WIND_MAX to set the failsafe threshold.
If enabled, it is not possible to resume the mission or switch to any auto mode other than
RTL or Land if this threshold is exceeded. Taking over in any manual
mode is still possible.

COM_WIND_WARN.description:
A warning is triggered if the currently estimated wind speed is above this value.
Warning is sent periodically (every 1 minute).
Set to -1 to disable.

NAV_DLL_ACT.summary: Set GCS connection loss failsafe mode
NAV_DLL_ACT.description:
The GCS connection loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_DL_LOSS_T in seconds. Once the timeout occurs the selected
action will be executed.

NAV_RCL_ACT.summary: Set manual control loss failsafe mode
NAV_RCL_ACT.description:
The manual control loss failsafe will only be entered after a timeout,
set by COM_RC_LOSS_T in seconds.

EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM.summary: Maximum IMU accel magnitude that allows IMU bias learning
EKF2_ABL_ACCLIM.description: If the magnitude of the IMU accelerometer vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of high manoeuvre accelerations and IMU nonlinerity and scale factor errors on the accel bias estimates.

EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM.summary: Maximum IMU gyro angular rate magnitude that allows IMU bias learning
EKF2_ABL_GYRLIM.description: If the magnitude of the IMU angular rate vector exceeds this value, the EKF accel bias state estimation will be inhibited. This reduces the adverse effect of rapid rotation rates and associated errors on the accel bias estimates.

EKF2_ABL_LIM.description: The ekf accel bias states will be limited to within a range equivalent to +- of this value.

EKF2_ABL_TAU.summary: Accel bias learning inhibit time constant
EKF2_ABL_TAU.description: The vector magnitude of angular rate and acceleration used to check if learning should be inhibited has a peak hold filter applied to it with an exponential decay. This parameter controls the time constant of the decay.

EKF2_ACC_B_NOISE.summary: Process noise for IMU accelerometer bias prediction

EKF2_AGP0_CTRL.description: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Horizontal position fusion 1 : Vertical position fusion

EKF2_AGP0_DELAY.summary: Auxiliary global position sensor 0 delay (to IMU)

EKF2_AGP0_GATE.summary: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 0 fusion
EKF2_AGP0_GATE.description: Sets the number of standard deviations used by the innovation consistency test.

EKF2_AGP0_ID.description: Sensor ID for slot 0. Set to 0 to disable this slot.

EKF2_AGP0_MODE.description: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP0_NOISE.summary: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 0

EKF2_AGP1_MODE.description: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP1_NOISE.summary: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 1

EKF2_AGP2_GATE.summary: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 2 fusion

EKF2_AGP2_ID.description: Sensor ID for slot 2. Set to 0 to disable this slot.

EKF2_AGP2_MODE.description: Automatic: reset on fusion timeout if no other source of position is available Dead-reckoning: reset on fusion timeout if no source of velocity is available

EKF2_AGP2_NOISE.summary: Measurement noise for auxiliary global position sensor 2
EKF2_AGP2_NOISE.description: Used to lower bound or replace the uncertainty included in the message

EKF2_AGP3_CTRL.description: Set bits in the following positions to enable: 0 : Horizontal position fusion 1 : Vertical position fusion

EKF2_AGP3_DELAY.summary: Auxiliary global position sensor 3 delay (to IMU)

EKF2_AGP3_GATE.summary: Gate size for auxiliary global position sensor 3 fusion

EKF2_AGP3_ID.description: Sensor ID for slot 3. Set to 0 to disable this slot.
